title: Application for Child Adjustment of Status (AOS)
subtitle: Child Green Card (Adjustment of Status)
description: adjusting your child's status to permanent resident while they are in the United States

sections.title: Petitioner (U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder) Documents

documents.name: Proof of U.S. citizenship OR green card (front and back)
documents.hint: U.S. citizens: upload your U.S. passport bio page, birth certificate, or Certificate of Naturalization. Green card holders: upload both the FRONT and BACK of your Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551).

documents.name: Government-issued photo ID
documents.hint: Upload a valid driver's license, state ID, or U.S. passport showing your full legal name, date of birth, and photo.

documents.name: Child's birth certificate showing sponsoring parent's name
documents.hint: Upload the child's official birth certificate listing your name as the parent. Include a certified English translation if the certificate is not in English.

documents.name: If adopted: final adoption decree + proof of legal custody and residency before age 16
documents.hint: Upload the final court adoption decree plus documentation showing the child lived with you before their 16th birthday (e.g., school enrollment records or medical records at the same address).

documents.name: If stepchild: marriage certificate between parent and stepparent + proof of prior marriage terminations
documents.hint: Upload the marriage certificate between the petitioning step-parent and the child's biological parent, and any divorce decrees or death certificates for prior marriages.

documents.name: If father & child born out of wedlock: legitimation proof or emotional/financial relationship evidence
documents.hint: Upload a court order establishing paternity, acknowledgment of paternity records, or documented evidence of an ongoing parent-child relationship.

documents.name: Paternal or maternal DNA test result from a USCIS-approved lab
documents.hint: If other documents cannot establish the parent-child relationship, a DNA test from an AABB-accredited lab may be submitted. Contact us before arranging a DNA test.

sections.title: At Least Five (5) of the Following — Required

documents.name: Medical/health records showing parent and child's names
documents.hint: Examples: vaccination records or health insurance cards listing both parent and child.

documents.name: Church or religious records listing parent and child's name
documents.hint: Examples: baptism certificate or religious school enrollment records showing both parent and child.

documents.name: Insurance records naming both petitioner and beneficiary
documents.hint: Upload insurance policies (health, life) listing both the petitioner and the child.

documents.name: Employment records showing parent and child's names
documents.hint: Examples: employer benefit enrollment forms listing the child as a dependent.

documents.name: Financial records (tax returns) listing parent and child's name
documents.hint: Upload IRS Form 1040 pages listing the child as a dependent.

documents.name: Census or tribal records in both names
documents.hint: Upload census household records or tribal documents listing both parent and child.

documents.name: Government records or ID documents showing both names
documents.hint: Examples: school enrollment records listing the petitioning parent, or any government document tying parent and child.

documents.name: Proof of ongoing parent-child relationship (money transfers/remittance)
documents.hint: Upload money transfer records or remittances to the child or their caretaker, showing ongoing financial support.

documents.name: Child's birth certificate (with certified English translation if needed)
documents.hint: Upload the child's official birth certificate. If not in English, include a full certified English translation.

documents.name: Passport biographic page
documents.hint: Upload the child's current passport bio page showing full name, date of birth, nationality, and photo.

documents.name: Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record
documents.hint: Download the child's I-94 from cbp.dhs.gov/I94 and upload the printout showing entry date, visa class, and authorized stay.

documents.name: Proof of lawful entry (visa, admission stamp, or parole documents)
documents.hint: Upload the visa stamp in the child's passport, a CBP entry stamp, or CBP/USCIS parole authorization documents.

documents.name: Most recent 3 years IRS tax return, transcript, or Form 1040 with W-2s
documents.hint: Upload your last 3 years of federal tax returns, including all W-2s and 1099s.

documents.name: Employment verification letter and/or 6 months' pay stubs OR proof of self-employment
documents.hint: Upload an employer letter and your last 6 months of pay stubs. If self-employed, upload business tax returns and a signed self-employment income statement.

documents.name: 6 months' bank statements
documents.hint: Upload the most recent 6 months of personal bank account statements.

documents.name: Evidence of assets (if income is insufficient)
documents.hint: Upload property deeds, investment/brokerage statements, or vehicle titles if additional asset evidence is needed.

documents.name: Joint sponsor: proof of U.S. citizenship OR green card
documents.hint: Upload citizenship proof or both sides of the green card for the joint sponsor.

documents.name: Joint sponsor: government-issued photo ID
documents.hint: Upload a valid photo ID for the joint sponsor.

documents.name: Joint sponsor: most recent 3 years IRS tax return or transcript
documents.hint: Upload the last 3 years of federal tax returns or IRS transcripts for the joint sponsor.

documents.name: Joint sponsor: 1099s and/or W-2s for the most recent tax year
documents.hint: Upload all W-2 and 1099 forms for the joint sponsor for the most recent tax year.

documents.name: Joint sponsor: employment verification/6 mo pay stubs OR proof of self-employment
documents.hint: Upload an employer letter and 6 months of pay stubs, or self-employment tax records, for the joint sponsor.

documents.name: Household member: proof of U.S. citizenship OR green card
documents.hint: Upload citizenship proof or both sides of the green card for the contributing household member.

documents.name: Household member: government-issued photo ID
documents.hint: Upload a valid photo ID for the contributing household member.

documents.name: Household member: most recent 3 years IRS tax return or transcript
documents.hint: Upload the last 3 years of tax returns or IRS transcripts for the contributing household member.

documents.name: Household member: 1099s and/or W-2s for the most recent tax year
documents.hint: Upload all income tax forms for the contributing household member for the most recent year.

documents.name: Household member: employment verification/6 mo pay stubs OR proof of self-employment
documents.hint: Upload an employer letter and 6 months of pay stubs, or self-employment records, for the contributing household member.

documents.name: Marriage certificate, divorce decree, adoption decree, or court order for name changes (if applicable)
documents.hint: Upload legal documents that explain any name discrepancies or changes in family status.
